description: This Java source file defines the REST API resource class 'MeetingsApiResource' for managing meetings in the Apache Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting meetings, and additional operations like template generation and attendance commands. The class uses JAX-RS annotations for RESTful API definitions, Swagger annotations for documentation, and integrates with various services and serializers to handle meeting data and security.

classes.name: MeetingsApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class providing endpoints to manage meetings, including CRUD operations, templates, and attendance handling in the Fineract platform.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Provides a template for creating or viewing meeting details, including clients and calendar data, with optional prefilled calendar information.

methods.name: retrieveMeetings
methods.description: Retrieves a list of meetings associated with a specific entity, with optional limit.

methods.name: retrieveMeeting
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific meeting, including client attendance data.

methods.name: createMeeting
methods.description: Creates a new meeting for a specified resource type and ID using provided JSON data.

methods.name: performMeetingCommands
methods.description: Performs commands on a meeting such as saving or updating attendance based on command parameter.

methods.name: updateMeeting
methods.description: Updates existing meeting details with new data.

methods.name: is
methods.description: Helper method to compare command string with expected value, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getResourceDetails
methods.description: Constructs command wrapper with resource-specific IDs for operations.
